title: Movix v2.3.2 - Server Default Multi-Audio Switcher & Seamless Playback
changelog: Server Default In-Player Language Change: Integrated VidLink Pro 4K Multi-Audio as Server 1 with native in-player audio switcher (⚙️/🎵) supporting Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, English and regional dubs seamlessly
No-Interruption Playback: Eliminated disruptive iframe reloads, video restart to 0:00, and query parameter poisoning when selecting audio languages
Unobstructed Touch Controls: Removed top touch-blocking overlay and floating pill; 100% of player screen is directly responsive to in-player gear/audio selectors
Clean Embed URLs: Streaming sources now deliver pristine parameters preventing server-side playback errors
